# Sample Recorder level meter (2.0.1 user report "metering seems slow"):
# with a moving input (--line-in-tone bursts) the meter redraws at >= 25 fps.
wait 300
tap SAMPLERECORDER
expect-screen Sample Recorder
wait 500
fps-reset
wait 3000
expect-fps 25
# While recording, the time / waveform view keeps redrawing (regression of
# the faster meter: it froze at "Recording 0.1 s").
tap REC
wait 500
fps-reset
wait 2000
expect-fps 15
